postprocess_notes.purpose: Improve measurable streaming-demo delivery after Lyria generation. This does not replace a human mix engineer with real multitracks.

stem_processing.warning: Separated stems from a mastered MP3 are approximate and may contain artifacts or bleed.

audio_sidechain.purpose: No-MIDI audio-triggered ducking for kick/808 conflict reduction.
audio_sidechain.preferred_source: Use clean drum/kick sidechain and bass/808 target stems when available.
audio_sidechain.fallback_source: If only a mixed MP3 is available, spectral mode applies approximate low-band ducking to the full mix.
audio_sidechain.warning: This approximates Trackspacer/Soothe2-style spectral unmasking. It cannot perfectly recreate commercial plugin DSP or recover clean 808/Rhodes separation from a mixed MP3.
